paper.title_en: Moore--Read construction and explicit monodromies of Laughlin states on Riemann surfaces
paper.abstract_en: We revisit the Moore--Read construction of the $ν=1/k$ Laughlin states on compact Riemann surfaces, deriving their conformal blocks from $U(1)_k$ Chern--Simons theory through the CS/WZW correspondence. We compute their explicit monodromies under quasi-hole transport and Aharonov--Bohm flux insertion, and prove that the monodromies associated with flux insertion asymptotically coincide with the corresponding physical adiabatic holonomies. In particular, we prove that the physical $L^2$ metric on the vector bundle of Laughlin states over the Jacobian is asymptotically projectively flat. We also relate our construction to the recently developed algebro-geometric approach to higher genus Laughlin states.
